j4q.physics

Class RigidBody

  • java.lang.Object
    • j4q.models.Component
      • j4q.physics.RigidBody
  • Direct Known Subclasses:
    RigidBox, RigidCylinder, RigidPlane, RigidSphere

    public class RigidBody
extends Component
    Represents a physical rigid body component for a GameObject.

    Integrates with Bullet Physics for simulation, supporting kinematic and dynamic modes.
